name: @stubbedev/win-rdp-mcp
description: Control a Windows machine over RDP as MCP tools — screenshots, mouse/keyboard, PowerShell, files, registry. Give it only RDP credentials.

scripts.bundle: go build -o win-rdp-mcp . && packaging/mcpb/pack.sh ./win-rdp-mcp $(case $(uname -s) in Darwin) echo darwin;; MINGW*|MSYS*) echo win32;; *) echo linux;; esac) dist/win-rdp-mcp.mcpb
scripts.preversion: go vet ./... && npm run test && npm run smoke
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && git push origin HEAD --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && git push origin HEAD --follow-tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major && git push origin HEAD --follow-tags
